docs.text: AgentScope Runtime 沙箱环境快速部署 概述 AgentScope Runtime的Sandbox提供了一个安全且隔离的环境，用于工具执行、浏览器自动化、文件系统操作、训练评测等功能。本方案部署了一套运程沙箱环境，远程沙箱服务器使您能够将沙箱部署为独立服务，提供资源隔离和集中管理等优势，您可以通过沙箱SDK连接到远程沙箱服务器。 访问 AgentScope Runtime 官网 查看详情。 部署流程 访问服务 部署链接 ，按提示填写部署参数： 参数填写完成后可以看到对应询价明细，确认参数后点击 下一步：确认订单 。 确认订单完成后同意服务协议并点击 立即创建 进入部署阶段。 等待部署完成后进入服务实例概览页, 可以看到沙箱服务器地址和访问沙箱服务器的bear_token。 使用示例 沙箱类型为Python代码及Shell命令执行 远程连接沙箱服务器（您也可以在本机操作），参考 官方文档 安装Agentscope Runtime的稳定版本，创建脚本并运行。 示例脚本如下： ```python from agentscope_runtime.sandbox import BaseSandbox # 连接到远程服务器（替换为您的实际沙箱服务器地址和bear_token） with BaseSandbox( base_url="沙箱服务器地址", bearer_token="沙箱服务器bear_token", ) as sandbox: # 正常使用沙箱 result = sandbox.run_shell_command(command="echo 'Hello from remote!'") print(result) ``` 沙箱类型为Web浏览器自动化 远程连接沙箱服务器（您也可以在本机操作）参考 官方文档 安装Agentscope Runtime的稳定版本，创建脚本并运行。 示例脚本如下： ```python from agentscope_runtime.sandbox import BrowserSandbox import time import websockets # 连接到远程服务器（替换为您的实际沙箱服务器地址和bear_token） with BrowserSandbox( base_url="沙箱服务器地址", bearer_token="沙箱服务器bear_token", ) as sandbox: # 正常使用沙箱 print(sandbox.browser_ws) time.sleep(5) # wait for health check input("Press Enter to kill sandbox...") ``` 创建出沙箱后，会得到一个websocket 连接，通过这个websocket 连接，可以访问browser_use的功能，可以复制得到的websocket 连接，替换到以下示例HTML中547行的baseWsUrl 中，访问此html，就可以访问沙箱的浏览器。 在地址栏可以访问网址 示例HTML 通过MCP调用沙箱服务 沙箱环境部署成功后，可以创建对应的MCP Server, 通过MCP的方式调用沙箱服务。这里介绍通过百炼的方式创建MCP Server，并使用的流程。在百炼中创建MCP 服务器，使用脚本创建的方式 配置MCP 服务器的信息，安装方式选择uvx, MCP 服务配置使用以下Json， 其中base_url为沙箱服务器地址，bearer_token为沙箱服务器的bear_token。 { "mcpServers": { "code_interpreter": { "command": "uvx", "args": [ "--from", "agentscope-runtime[sandbox]", "runtime-sandbox-mcp", "--type=base", "--base_url=http://沙箱服务器地址:8000", "--bearer_token=xxx" ] } } } 创建MCP Server成功后，可以查看MCP Server 的工具列表 在MCP Client 中配置成功后，Agent 就可以通过MCP Server 调用沙箱服务了。比如下图，通过沙箱执行python 脚本 更多用法请参考 官方示例 。

docs.text: AgentScope Runtime sandbox environment for rapid deployment Overview AgentScope Runtime Sandbox provides a secure and isolated environment for tool execution, browser automation, file system manipulation, training profiling, and more. This solution deploys a transport sandbox environment. The remote sandbox server enables you to deploy the sandbox as an independent service, providing advantages such as resource isolation and centralized management. You can connect to the remote sandbox server through the sandbox SDK. Visit AgentScope Runtime website for details. Deployment process Access the service Deployment Link and fill in the deployment parameters as prompted: After completing the parameters, you can see the corresponding RFQ details. After confirming the parameters, click Next: Confirm Order . Confirm the order and agree to the service agreement and click Create Now to enter the deployment phase. After the deployment is complete, go to the service instance overview page, you can see the address of the sandbox server and the bear_token of accessing the sandbox server. Use example The sandbox type is Python code and Shell command execution Connect to the sandbox server remotely (you can also operate on this machine), refer to official documents Install the stable version of the Agentscope Runtime, create the script and run it. The sample script is as follows: '''python from agentscope_runtime.sandbox import BaseSandbox Connect to the remote server (replace with your actual sandbox server address and bear_token) with BaseSandbox ( base_url = "Sandbox Server Address", bearer_token = "Sandbox Server bear_token", ) as sandbox: Normal use of sandbox result = sandbox.run_shell_command(command="echo 'Hello from remote! '") print(result) ''' Sandbox type for web browser automation Connect to the sandbox server remotely (you can also operate locally) refer to Official Documents Install the stable version of the Agentscope Runtime, create the script and run it. The sample script is as follows: '''python from agentscope_runtime.sandbox import BrowserSandbox import time import websockets Connect to the remote server (replace with your actual sandbox server address and bear_token) with BrowserSandbox ( base_url = "Sandbox Server Address", bearer_token = "Sandbox Server bear_token", ) as sandbox: Normal use of sandbox print(sandbox.browser_ws) time.sleep(5) # wait for health check input("Press Enter to kill sandbox...") ''' After creating the sandbox, you will get a websocket connection. Through this websocket connection, you can access the functions of the browser_use. You can copy the obtained websocket connection and replace it with the baseWsUrl of line 547 in the following sample HTML. If you access this html, you can access the sandbox browser. URL can be accessed in the address bar Sample HTML Call the sandbox service through MCP After the sandbox environment is successfully deployed, you can create a corresponding MCP server and call the sandbox service through MCP. This section describes the process of creating an MCP server and using it. Create an MCP server in Bailian and use the method of script creation. Configure the information of the MCP server. Select uvx as the installation method. MCP service configuration uses the following Json, where base_url is the address of the sandbox server and bearer_token is the bear_token of the sandbox server. '''json { "mcpServers ": { "code_interpreter": { "command": "uvx ", "args ": [ "--from ", "agentscope-runtime[sandbox] ", "runtime-sandbox-mcp", "--type=base ", "-- base_url = http:// sandbox server address: 8000", "--bearer_token=xxx" ] } } } ''' After creating MCP Server successfully, you can view the tool list of MCP Server After the MCP Client is configured successfully, the Agent can call the sandbox service through the MCP Server. For example, as shown in the following figure, the python script is executed through the sandbox. For more usage, please refer to official example .
